routing_principle: Signals route between independent services; no service is embedded as a private subroutine of another.

routes.rule: Incident service opens RCA and assigns work orders; each downstream service repairs only its own owned class.
Research creates or blocks evidence; editorial may only project verified science into documents.
Editorial rebuilds document structure and traceability; research supplies missing science, release engineering packages it.
Release engineering fixes package/version/space migration machinery; it must not rewrite scientific claims.
Publication records executes or repairs public records after approved artifacts pass gates.
Safety blocks scope leaks and token/path leaks; publication waits for clearance.
